data.one_liner: A collection of miscellaneous Flutter widgets, date pickers, and input components.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large set of ready-to-use Flutter widgets such as accordions, alerts, color pickers, checkboxes, date fields, dividers, carousels, and search bars used across various projects.
use_when: You need standard utility widgets and input fields without writing them from scratch
You want common UI components like accordions, ratings, and color pickers bundled together
avoid_when: You require a strictly designed, cohesive enterprise design system or specific UI-kit aesthetic
You only need a single component and want to minimize dependency bloat
strengths: Includes a wide variety of helpful custom widgets and form fields
Easy to drop into any Flutter application
weaknesses: Acts as an unopinionated personal collection of various unrelated widgets
Not documented in detail beyond feature lists and screenshots
